findings.where: Article specimen: the pull quote "Whichever PPP Law I am currently working on with a client country!"
findings.fault: The quote is set in logo blue. The palette gives that colour to links and the button, and the link just below it in the same specimen is the same blue. A static quote borrows the link colour, so on an article page blue no longer means only 'this goes somewhere'.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank reader on one of Mark's article pages. They learn from the lecture link that blue text acts, then find a large blue line that does nothing. Once Angélique adds posts with real links in body text, a blue quote among them gets clicked or makes the real links less clear.

findings.where: Hero: the "Get in touch" button (mailto:Mark.Moseley@MMMinfra.com), and the nav's "Contact"
findings.fault: The page's one action only opens a mail program. The address appears nowhere on the page as text, so a visitor with no mail client set up, or one who reads their mail in a browser, gets nothing or a stray app window, and has no address to copy. The arrow on the button suggests it leads to a page, not a mail program.
findings.who_objects: A visitor on a locked-down agency laptop or using webmail. They decide to contact Mark, click, and have no way to finish, so the page loses the one action it exists for.

findings.where: Header nav (Profile, Articles, Blog, Contact) and the article specimen's lecture link "Streamlining the PPP Process…"
findings.fault: Every nav item and the lecture link points to "#", so each is a dead action. "Contact" goes nowhere, while "Get in touch" opens mail, so the same action has two different results on one page.
findings.who_objects: A visitor who looks for Mark in the nav, the usual place, clicks "Contact" or "Profile" and gets nothing. The tile's evidence that the nav works is unproven.

findings.fault: A button that acts on the page (replays the heading animation) is styled exactly like the underlined blue text links. One look means two functions: go somewhere and do something here.
findings.who_objects: The layout round, which builds inside this tile and would copy the treatment. A reader of the tile who expects the underlined blue text to open a page finds it does something here instead.
